segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found the shea butter content a bit heavy and uses the serum sparingly, but reports no clogged pores or breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several describe it as deeply hydrating and soothing for patchy, flaky skin, while others report tightness, stinging, or barrier damage after use.
segments.combination: One reviewer unsure if her skin is dry, acne-prone or combination reports reduced dry patches and no new cheek breakouts after 1.5 months.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin reviewers are divided: some describe severe stinging, redness, tightness and barrier damage within days, while others (including one with extremely sensitive, dry skin) call it soothing with no irritation.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (late 30s to 60s) frequently report visible softening of fine lines, firmer and plumper skin, and a more radiant complexion.

concerns.aging: Multiple mature and aging-concerned reviewers report softer fine lines, firmer and plumper skin, and improved elasticity, some noticing results within days; no dissent on this concern.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as very hydrating and plumping, with skin feeling soft and smooth; one reviewer with very dry skin found no noticeable improvement in moisture after several weeks.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with eczema or general redness report the serum soothed red, flaky patches and reduced redness over weeks; no negative reports specific to redness were found.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe the serum as having shredded or ruined their moisture barrier with stinging, tightness and cracking, particularly when combined with other actives; others with dry or sensitive skin report no barrier issues and describe it as soothing.
concerns.spots: One reviewer noted the serum helped with melasma; no other spot-specific reports were found.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report new breakouts (whiteheads, blackheads, cystic-looking red bumps) that resolved after stopping use; other acne-prone reviewers, including one with hormonal acne, report calmer skin and no breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin found the formula slightly heavy due to shea butter and uses it sparingly, but did not report increased oiliness or clogged pores.

extraits.texte: Started using this peptide serum and immediately my skin felt tight after first use especially since I have dry skin which I have never experienced with any other peptide serum. The packaging itself is very inconvenient because you can't open it and you can't see through how much product there is. Also the pump stops working after a while. But at the end of the day and when I finish this product this DESTROYED my skin. All my holy Grail products now burn and My Skin barrier is absolutely ruined! For somebody who has a dry, sensitive, acne prone skin... I do not recommend this product.

I did so much research on this product and so many (paid) influencers with similar skin types to me (reactive, sensitive, hormonal acne prone) said it was great for plumpness and fine lines. Unfortunately, this product seems to have shredded my impeccable moisture barrier almost instantly. I used it for three days (once daily) in combination with the peptide moisturizer. By day 3, I felt severe stinging. My skin is now red, irritated, extremely tight and cracked looking in appearance. Immediately stopped use and am rolling back all actives until I can fix the damage. Not for me!

extraits.titre: Solid anti-aging Peptide Serum that absorbs well
extraits.texte: Love that the formula has copper peptides with an encapsulated delivery system to help it absorb into skin. I have oily skin, however, so I can only use sparingly because the Shea Butter makes it a little heavy for my very oily skin. I use sparing in winter drier months. If the formulation did not have Shea Butter and was also a bit lighter, I would give this 5 stars and use this peptide product all year round. That being said, this Peptide did not cause any clop pores or acne even with the shea butter and thicker texture for my oily clog prone skin.

I am a 38 year old woman with sensitive acne prone skin. This stuff is like magic for my skin! I use it every night. It pairs well with my exfoliator and my retinol (also naturium). My acne has calmed way down since using this. I wake up and my skin is soft and plumped. I have been using it for a couple months and have absolutely no complaints. I will be getting the larger size next time!
